name: weighted bag good morning
description: Hinging forward with a weighted bag on your back trains the hamstrings, glutes and lower back. It teaches a strong hip hinge.
instructions: Place the weighted bag across your upper back and hold it in place.
Stand with your feet hip width and your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Go down until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep your neck neutral all the way.
